coverageAssessment.claimedScope: No city-specific open parcel scope verified in this research pass. Country-level evidence is not attributed to this urban centre.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No target-area sheet returned/intersected in the bounded selector/sheet checks.
coverageAssessment.finding: The official Saghata Upazila Land Office portal confirms local land administration. Separately, DLRS listed Gaibandha district RS/BRS survey 201901 but its GetThanaListBySurveyMap result was empty, so no Saghata mouza/sheet was available in that active survey selector. No parcel geometry was verified; this is not proof of absent cadastral records or other survey editions.

nextStep: The active Gaibandha survey chain returned no upazila entries. Check other survey editions / selector codes for Gaibandha and recheck whether Saghata appears; request a single sheet only after the exact target mouza is exposed.
